query:
SELECT month AS period, channel AS segment, SUM(margin) AS value
FROM sales_lines
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
summary: Nothing unusual for margin by channel in period 2025-Q2 (threshold 2.5).. No sales at all for: Reseller 2025-05, Reseller 2025-06
